headline: WAM Leaders (WLE) compared to WMX as a long-only equity vehicle with narrower mandate and different portfolio construction constraints
reasoning: The speaker contrasts WLE as a long-only equity manager constrained to equities only, meaning macro views can only be expressed through equity proxies such as bond proxies within the stock universe. This limits flexibility relative to WMX which can directly buy bonds or other assets. The speaker notes there is meaningful crossover in stock holdings between the two portfolios given both fish in the ASX 200/300 universe, but the weights differ significantly due to structural differences in the mandates.
quote: when you're constrained to equities only but yet you're macro aware um you will see opportunities to go out there and buy government bonds or credit or commodities or something which is not in equities but you'll see the macro theme but if you're stuck only in equities you actually have very limited ways of expressing that uh and so your portfolio weights will reflect that whereas if you like bonds you don't have to go and necessarily chalk up on all the bond proxies within the equity space you just go out and buy bonds and do something else with the equities if you so chose
